references.text: The Lord was also angry with me because of you and said: You shall not enter there either.
The Lord was angry with me on your account and would not listen to me. The Lord said to me: Enough! Do not speak to me again about this matter.
Moses explains that he cannot cross the Jordan because the Lord has told him so.
The Lord shows Moses the land but confirms that he will not be allowed to cross over there.
The account of the Lord's judgment against Moses at the waters of Meribah because he did not honor the Lord as holy.
The Lord explains that Moses was disobedient at the waters of Meribah in the wilderness of Zin.
The psalm mentions that the people made the Lord angry at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses on their account.
